content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Lok Nayak Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lok Nayak Hospital is conducting this recruitment drive to fill various Senior Resident positions on an ad-hoc contract basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 60 vacancies available for Senior Resident posts across various specialized medical and surgical departments at Lok Nayak Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree or Diploma (PG, DNB, MS, or MD) in the relevant specialized discipline to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline through a walk-in interview. Eligible candidates directly report to the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per the pay matrix of level-11, ranging from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 along with other usual allowances.
